stem.en: Is each statement about attention and constraints true or false?

text.en: Attention moves information from one position to another.
Attention alone does all the adding and multiplying.
A constraint is something that must be true.
A soft constraint solver always finds an answer that fits every rule.

explanation.en: Attention moves information between positions. Other parts of each round combine and change it. A constraint is something that must be true, like "the total is 4 x 6". Soft means learned and likely, so a model can still break a rule.

hints.en: Think about which part gathers and which parts combine.
